primaryEndpoint.name: firstStageKnownClaimRateDifference
primaryEndpoint.formula: Pr(known claim | criterion first) - Pr(known claim | product first)

categoricalDistributionGuardrail.exclusionAction: Not a word/name is reported separately and is not renormalized into the knowledge-response distribution

jointDecisionRule.equivalenceSupported: primary endpoint and categorical-distribution guardrail both satisfy their separately approved equivalence criteria
jointDecisionRule.primaryPassGuardrailFail: interference not ruled out; confirmatory collection remains blocked
jointDecisionRule.primaryPassGuardrailInconclusive: interference not ruled out; confirmatory collection remains blocked
jointDecisionRule.primaryFail: material or inconclusive primary interference; confirmatory collection remains blocked

unblockRule: independent statistical review must select and freeze the primary margin and a decision-relevant categorical-distribution equivalence guardrail, including estimator, uncertainty, multiplicity, and support, before real developmental collection
